# requires frame

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:requiresFrame`](gmeow-requiresFrame.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/requiresFrame>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Declares that every instance of the annotated class must carry the named reference-frame property (CONSTITUTION P11): 'a value asserted without its frame is ill-formed'. The frame-relativity SHACL shape is GENERATED from this declaration — exactly one frame when the named property is [owl:FunctionalProperty](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#FunctionalProperty), at least one otherwise — so a new frame-relative value class is enforced the moment it is declared, never by remembering to hand-write its shape. Pair with [`gmeow:frameRequirementSeverity`](gmeow-frameRequirementSeverity.md) "warning" to downgrade from violation.
